groups.activity: conservation loop from the Cetus gate pond to the cave pond

rows.label: Visitor
rows.note: 25,000 cr, 10 Tear Azurite, 40 Pyrol, 60 Fish Scales

rows.label: Trusted
rows.note: 50,000 cr, 1 Cetus Wisp, 5 Maprico; unlocks gilding

conditions: The blueprint needs only Neutral, but gilding needs Trusted; early ranks have low caps, so this takes several days however fast you farm.
Hai-Luk doesn't warn when a fish turn-in goes over the daily cap; set the quantity by hand.
bonuses: Conservation caps the day in 10-15 minutes; leave and re-enter to respawn the animals. Ivara's Sleep Arrow replaces the tranq rifle.
Tusk Thumpers drop gems, ore and Coprite Alloy and can cap the day in about 10 minutes.

disclosures.title: fishing instead
disclosures.body: Murkray (any time) and Glappid (night, south-east ocean) are the repeated picks, but bait now costs standing. Oxylus shows fishing hot spots on the minimap.

groups.activity: buy the Strike, a Grip and a Link

rows.label: any base Grip
rows.note: 1,000 standing; one-handed makes a machete, two-handed a polearm

conditions: Grip and Link add no Mastery; pick the ones whose materials you already hold, and check current costs in the Forge preview.
Grip and Link are consumed; a built Zaw can't be taken apart.

groups.activity: mine, fish, break Grineer drums, collect Cetus Wisps
groups.meta: refine at Old Man Suumbaat, Offworlder

rows.label: Esher Devar
rows.note: 10 Devar (blue veins), 1,000 cr per batch of 10

rows.label: Cetus Wisp
rows.note: 1 for Trusted, 2 to gild; lake shores, mostly at night

conditions: The Esher Devar and Coprite Alloy refine blueprints cost 2,500 standing each from Old Man Suumbaat and need Offworlder.
Mining Devar and Coprun needs a mining tool.
bonuses: Gather these on the same Plains trips as the conservation loop.

groups.activity: build, assemble, level, gild, level again

rows.label: Kronsh Strike
rows.note: 5,000 cr, 20 Grokdrul, 45 Fish Scales, 10 Esher Devar, 60 Coprite Alloy, 1h

rows.label: level to 30, then gild at Hok
rows.note: 2 Cetus Wisp, 5,000 cr; resets to rank 0

conditions: An ungilded Zaw gives zero Mastery.
Hok takes rank-30 Zaws for standing; donate only after the gilded run to 30 is done.
Mastery belongs to the Kronsh Strike; later Zaws on Kronsh give no more.
